# Site-Survive Rapid Audit

Capability ID: site-survive-rapid-audit-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/site-survive-rapid-audit-v1/index.html
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- business outage plan
- internet outage continuity
- site resilience audit
- offline operations plan

## Problem

A site-dependent organization needs to understand which operational dependencies fail first during connectivity disruption.

## Inputs

Site/business context, critical workflows and a realistic outage scenario.

## Outputs

One-site continuity map with the three largest failure points and a prioritized action plan.

## Pricing

$250 one-time; may be credited toward a deeper $1,250 audit if the customer elects to continue.

- Site-Survive Rapid Audit: $250 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE fixed-price human review handoff through the central Machine Commerce MCP tool prepare_quote_ready_service_handoff. Discovery and qualification are machine-callable; payment and paid work remain explicitly human-confirmed.

Explicit buyer confirmation is required before payment or paid work.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; direct machine checkout is not exposed for this service.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
